name: Nakayoshi Oyako to 3P Dousei Seikatsu ~Gibo no Shidou de Fuufu Enman~
original_name: 仲良し母娘と3P同居生活 ～義母の指導で夫婦円満～
source:
Newlyweds [Kazuya] and [Misaki] live together with Misaki's mother [Eimi], and the three of them lead a life together.

One day, Kazuya returns home to pick up something he forgot and finds Misaki talking to Eimi about her sex life with Kazuya.

When Kazuya is discovered by the two, he asks his mother-in-law to teach him how to have sex with her.

[from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt283/apt283.html#link_story]official site[/url]]

新婚夫妇[Kazuya]和[Misaki]与美咲的母亲[Eimi]住在一起，三人一起过着生活。

有一天，和也回家取他忘记的东西，发现美咲正在和英美谈论她和和也的性生活。

当和也被两人发现时，他请求岳母教他如何与她发生性关系。
